note: ESPN archive games with no usable box score (zeroed or not adding up to the score), matched to NBA.com game ids by date (a day either side), teams and, where they agree, points (0.149.0). espn: the archive file(s) for the game.
missingNote: Regular-season games ESPN's scoreboards do not list at all (4/18-19/2000, and five others), written into the archive from NBA.com as new files. BOS-IND 4/16/13 (cancelled after the Boston Marathon bombing) is not a game.
